definitions.gloss: going on to higher education, advancing to the next level of schooling
definitions.explanation: Continuing to a higher level of education, such as from high school to university.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}に{進学|しんがく}するかどうか{迷|まよ}っている。
examples.english: I'm unsure whether to go on to university.

examples.japanese: {進学|しんがく}{率|りつ}が{年々|ねんねん}{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: The rate of advancement to higher education is rising year by year.

examples.japanese: {進学|しんがく}{塾|じゅく}で{受験|じゅけん}{勉強|べんきょう}をしている。
examples.english: I'm studying for entrance exams at a cram school.

notes:
{進学|しんがく}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to advance to higher education."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進学|しんがく}する (to go on to higher education)
- {進学|しんがく}{率|りつ} (advancement rate)
- {進学|しんがく}{校|こう} (college preparatory school)
- {進学|しんがく}{塾|じゅく} (cram school for advancement)
- {進学|しんがく}{希望|きぼう} (desire to continue education)

CONTRAST:
- {進学|しんがく}: going to higher education
- {就職|しゅうしょく}: getting a job (alternative path after graduation)
